name: See Georgia: Lake Russell B 2024

venue.name: [Richard B. Russell State Park](https://gastateparks.org/RichardBRussell)
venue.address: 2650 Russell State Park Drive, Elberton, GA 30635

information: Entering and parking at Richard B. Russell State Park costs $5 per vehicle per day. Please review the [Travel](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeeGeorgiaLakeRussellB2024#41548-travel), [Venue](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeeGeorgiaLakeRussellB2024#41549-venue), and [Free Parking Through Your Local Library!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeeGeorgiaLakeRussellB2024#41550-free-parking-through-your-local-library) tabs before registering to ensure you have a plan to travel to and access the park. This competition takes place in conjunction with the Elberton, GA location of the worldwide [FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2024) competition, with FMC 2024 taking place on Saturday morning and this competition taking place during the day on Sunday. Please review the [FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeeGeorgiaLakeRussellB2024#41884-fmc-2024) tab if you are interested in participating in both competitions. This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/).
